eyebrow: Find a Word for your day
title: Tell us what’s on your heart.
description: Explore Scripture related to what you are experiencing.
query: What is happening in your life?
placeholder: I moved back home and feel disconnected from the people around me…
privacy: Your description is processed on this device. It is not sent to an AI service or saved to your journal.
required: Write at least three characters about your situation.
sampleNote: This experiment searches 50 World English Bible passages, not the whole Bible. Scripture and editorial context are in English.
downloadNote: The first search downloads a model of about 145 MB. Internet is needed for setup; later searches can use the cached model. This may take a few minutes on a phone.
offlineReady: The model and selected search data are cached. Offline reopening also requires the production app’s offline-ready message.
notCached: Search worked, but model files could not all be cached. Offline search is not ready.
interpretation: These are suggestions by similarity, not certainty or personalized guidance. An unrelated question can still return passages. Read their context and choose what is helpful.
score: Similarity: {{score}}. This is not a confidence percentage.
chapterNote: World English Bible Classic · English. The selected verses are highlighted.

errors.setup: Search setup failed. Connect to the internet for the first download, check available browser storage, and try again. Your text is still here.
errors.tooLong: This description exceeds the model’s reading limit. Try a shorter description.
errors.search: Search could not complete. Cancel and try again; if needed, reload the screen.

fullNote: Experimental search across 66 books and 9,534 passages of the World English Bible Classic. Scripture is in English. Relevance still needs review; feeling loved and unloved may produce unsuitable suggestions.
fullDownload: The first full-Bible search also downloads about 24.8 MB of text and vectors. Keep this page open until the search completes to prepare offline use.
emptyVerse: This edition has no main-body text for this verse marker; consult the official source notes.
chapterEditionNote: {{translation}} · English. The selected verses are highlighted.
selectedVerseNote: {{translation}} · English. This is the saved notification verse. Open the source link for the full chapter.
